description: Every human sentence the verifier prints. The issuer supplies integers, enumerated tokens and registry names only; it never supplies text.

cert.domain_only: bound by the domain only, without a vendor certificate
cert.vendor_certified: vouched for by the vendor root

dns.dns_unbound: not named by the domain's DNS

profile_line: profile: baseline (no acceptance policy given; nothing requires specific invariants)

reason_phrases.coverage_below_required: coverage is below the floor the invariant requires
reason_phrases.host_evidence_unusable: host evidence is missing, unsigned, partial or unusable
reason_phrases.other: undetermined for a reason this verifier does not name
reason_phrases.possible_via_unknown_edges: a path may exist through connections that are not fully known
reason_phrases.selection_too_large: the selectors overlap too much to decide
reason_phrases.zone_unknown: some assets have no known network zone

slot_types.enum:<name>: one of the keys of enums.<name>; the phrase is substituted
slot_types.name: registry name: printable ASCII, 1 to 120 characters, no quote, backtick, brace or backslash
slot_types.phrase: a phrase taken from this file or a fixed code message: printable ASCII, 1 to 200 characters, no quote, backtick, brace or backslash
slot_types.subject: dns:<domain> or paddock-estate:<estate id>

W-CHAIN-BROKEN.text: This attestation does not link to the previous one: updates may have been withheld or replaced.

W-CUSTOM-NAME.text: Custom invariant `{id}` (defined by the operator; not reviewed by Paddock)

W-DIGEST-CHANGED.text: An invariant's definition changed since the previous attestation.

W-DNS-UNBOUND.text: The domain's DNS does not name the signing key: this attestation is not bound to the domain.

W-ENGINE-ADVISORY.text: The engine version that produced this attestation has a known defect advisory.

W-FOOTER.text: A passing result means: no counterexample was found under this evidence, at this coverage, at this time. It is not a statement that the organisation is secure.

W-HOLDS.text: No counterexample found for "{name}", based on {tier_phrase}. {covered} of {universe} relevant assets had live evidence ({pct}%). Evidence current until {valid_until}.

W-HOLDS-EXPIRED.text: EXPIRED: the result for "{name}" was current until {valid_until}. It says nothing about now.

W-KEY-REVOKED.text: The signing key has been revoked.

W-POLICY.text: {disclosed} of {enabled} enabled invariants are disclosed ({disabled} declared invariants are disabled). {k} enabled invariants are not shown as holding: they may be violated, undetermined, not yet evaluated, or not disclosed. The issuer chooses what to disclose.

W-POLICY-SHRANK.text: The set of declared invariants is smaller than in the previous attestation.

W-ROLLBACK.text: This attestation is older than one seen before: the sequence number went backwards.

W-STD-MISSING.text: Standard invariants enabled but not disclosed: {n}.

W-STD-UNRECOGNISED.text: A standard invariant's definition is not the one this verifier knows.

W-SUPERSEDED.text: A newer statement or a supersession notice exists for this subject: this attestation is out of date.

W-UNKNOWN.text: Undetermined for "{name}": {reason_phrase}. This is not a pass.

W-VALID.text: This attestation is correctly signed by a key bound to {subject}, was issued {issued_at} and is current until {valid_until}. It lists results of specific checks. It is not an assessment of overall security.

tier_phrases.configured: configuration read from the systems (not tested from outside)
tier_phrases.declared: statements made by the operator (not measured)
tier_phrases.observed: observed network traffic or an outside-in scan
